bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for senior nutrition programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SENIOR NUTRITION PROGRAMS. +]

[+$11,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $11,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for senior nutrition programs under Minnesota Statutes, section 256.9752. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for senior nutrition programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SENIOR NUTRITION PROGRAMS.

$11,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $11,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for senior nutrition programs under Minnesota Statutes, section 256.9752.
additions: $11,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $11,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for senior nutrition programs under Minnesota Statutes, section 256.9752.
